lines.text: Many learners say: In my room has a big desk.
Better: My room has a big desk.
My room is what has the desk.
My room! My room has a big desk.

data.wrong: In my room has a big desk.
data.right: My room has a big desk.
data.why: My room is what has the desk.

native.tip: ‘내 방에 큰 책상이 있어요’의 ‘에’를 in으로 옮기기 쉬워요. has 앞에는 in 없이! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “My room has a big desk.”
native.caption: “In my room has a big desk”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 has 앞에는 주어가 와야 해서 in 없이 My room has라고 해요. ‘~에 있다’를 in으로 옮기면 어색해져요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “My room has a big desk.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Has needs a subject, so say my room has. Say “My room has a big desk.”
en.caption: Do you say “In my room has a big desk” in English? 😅 The word “has” needs a subject before it, so you do not add “in”! “My room has a big desk” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
